load_model: load a MuJoCo model from a file path, handling resources, plugins, and model overrides
init_structs: initialize Warp device structs including model, data, and optional render context for simulation
unroll: unroll a simulation function over batched data and return JIT compilation duration
run_simulation_with_noise: run a batched MuJoCo simulation with Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control noise on GPU
run_simulation_with_replay: run a batched MuJoCo simulation replaying control sequences from an NPZ trajectory file
